item.description:
ChatGPTX 1.2.0

Automatic launcher updates

ChatGPTX now checks for launcher updates automatically. It downloads and installs signed updates through Sparkle so that future launcher versions can arrive without a manual download.

The ChatGPTX application menu and status menu now show the current update state. You can check again, retry a failed check, or install a downloaded update from either menu.

This release does not change the separate update system for ChatGPT API bindings, the runtime, or extensions.
